subject.title: cron announce delivery triggers EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError when user is actively chatting

question: Does current main’s destination-session admission fully resolve the announce-to-active-session race, or is the retry/message-preservation work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039 still required?
rationale: Source now contains a plausible root-level serialization fix, but the latest shipped release has strong cross-channel reproductions and the open PR may address a complementary failure mode rather than duplicate the admission change.

options.title: Verify current main first
options.body: Run the active-turn cron and `sessions_send` race scenarios on current main, then retain only the linked PR work not covered by destination-session admission.

options.title: Land complementary retry handling
options.body: Keep lifecycle admission and also make takeover contention retryable so a residual writer cannot surface message loss or a permanently queued turn.

options.title: Treat admission as complete
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue only after identifying the admission fix commit and recording positive current-main behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Verify current main first
recommendation.body: Run the active-turn cron and `sessions_send` race scenarios on current main, then retain only the linked PR work not covered by destination-session admission.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest involvement in both the cron delivery implementation and its session persistence contract.
